name: fixer-execution
description: Evals for fixer agent behavior — does it execute bounded tasks correctly? Covers execution, research constraints, output format, and code quality.

evals.prompt: Add a validateEmail function to src/utils/validation.ts that checks for valid email format using regex. Do not use @librarian or @explorer — implement directly.
evals.description: Fixer should implement directly without spawning subagents or doing research

assertions.description: Output should contain email regex pattern

evals.prompt: Add a helloWorld function to src/utils/helpers.ts that returns the string 'Hello, World!'. Include summary, changes, and verification sections in the output.
evals.description: Fixer output should include summary, changes, and verification sections

evals.prompt: Add a safeParseJson function to src/utils/serialization.ts that parses JSON strings gracefully, returning null on invalid input. Do not delegate to @librarian or @explorer.
evals.description: Fixer should handle edge cases without research delegation

assertions.description: Output should handle invalid JSON by returning null

evals.prompt: Add a formatCurrency function to src/utils/formatters.ts that formats a number as currency string (e.g., 1234.56 → '$1,234.56'). Do not use @librarian or @explorer.
evals.description: Fixer should produce high-quality code without research delegation

assertions.description: Output should format as currency with $ and 2 decimal places
